preconditions.description: The number of intersections n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct intersections within the valid range.

postconditions.description: If routes can be created, output 'YES' followed by three valid routes; otherwise, output 'NO'.
Each route must contain at least two intersections.

postconditions.expression: all(route[0] == route[-1] for route in routes)
postconditions.description: Each route must start and end at the same intersection.
